value.rationale: The spectral transition is the central phenomenon of the source. The exact per-length population of guided states that remain inside the mass gap is a natural invariant of that transition and diverges with a sharp universal coefficient. Pairing this total-count law with the weaker square-root edge-amplitude divergence distinguishes two scales of spectral crowding and quantitatively explains the emergence of the infinitely degenerate flat band.
